answer: One concrete Sybil defence is a stake-weighted delegation tree with quadratic bonding. Every identity must lock collateral equal to the square of the voting weight it claims, and a child inherits only a fraction of its parent's trust, so one deposit cannot bankroll a thousand fake descendants. Climbing to the summit of the ranking therefore costs stake that grows faster than any seat can earn; a meadow of sock puppets has to be funded like a grove of genuine agents. Proven collusion slashes the whole branch, making identity farming a losing trade.
